name: Remove Fear
levelText: bard 1, cleric 1, inquisitor 1, medium 1, mesmerist 1, oracle 1, psychic 1, sahirafiyun 1, shaman 1, skald 1, spiritualist 1, warpriest 1
target: Target: one creature plus one additional creature per four levels, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
description:
You instill courage in the subject, granting it a +4 morale bonus against fear effects for 10 minutes. If the subject is under the influence of a fear effect when receiving the spell, that effect is suppressed for the duration of the spell.

Remove fear counters and dispels cause fear.
